title: CoralTemp v3.1 coral SST has steps in mid-1995, November 2002 and January 2008 that cause its 1985-2025 warming excess over in situ SST and 8-28% of a reef heat-stress trend
abstract: Question: NOAA Coral Reef Watch (CRW) CoralTemp v3.1 joins three inputs (OSTIA reanalysis to October 2002, Geo-Polar reanalysis to September 2016, near-real-time Geo-Polar after). The Geo-Polar bias reference also changed in January 2008. Do these input changes put steps into CoralTemp, and do the steps bias CRW reef heat stress (Degree Heating Weeks, DHW)? Approach: we compared CoralTemp with ERSSTv5 and HadSST4.2 (in situ), DOISST v2.1, ESA SST CCI v3.0.1 (satellite only) and 128 moored buoys, with joint step models, placebo dates and a blind break search (1985-2025, 1-degree sample, 60S-60N). We then applied the CRW v3.1 heat-stress method to 738 reef pixels in 16 reef boxes, with and without the steps. Results: at 30S-30N CoralTemp falls by 0.04-0.09 C in mid-1995 (undocumented; found by the blind search in all reference series), rises by 0.055-0.091 C at the November 2002 join and by 0.062-0.065 C in January 2008, relative to the in situ products. The October 2016 join has no step. CCI confirms 2002 (+0.094 C) and 2008 (+0.059 C); at the buoys CoralTemp minus buoy changes by -0.090, +0.076 and +0.063 C. CoralTemp warms 0.033-0.036 C per decade faster than ERSSTv5 and HadSST4.2; with step terms the excess is 0.000-0.002. The variance of the 1-day change also rises 2.4-fold at the 2002 join. Relative to its fixed 1985-2012 bleaching climatology, 2017-2025 CoralTemp is about 0.11 C too warm. The 1986-2025 trend of annual maximum DHW at the reef pixels is +1.17 C-weeks per decade in published CoralTemp, +0.84 with the mean steps removed and +0.91 to +1.08 when the sub-monthly noise is also matched to one segment: 8-28% of the trend is artifact. In 2024, DHW >= 4 occurs at 90% of these reef pixels in published CoralTemp and at 77% with the mean steps removed. The rise of reef heat stress and the 2024 record stay true in every version. Limitations: the references have their own errors; CCI was fetched only near the change dates; the reef sample is 16 boxes at 0.25-degree spacing; the cause of the 1995 step is not identified.

24-month window steps of CoralTemp minus the mean of ERSSTv5 and HadSST4.2 in 5-degree boxes at the four dates. The windows also contain ENSO and regional variability, so single boxes are noisy.
